0022600223.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-6, 11th in the West and 5th in the Southwest) host the Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 13th in the East), with the Pelicans riding a two-game losing streak at home (3-3) and the Nets also on a two-game skid on the road (1-5). Trendon Watford (ankle), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis), Yves Missi (knee bruise) and Zion Williamson (rest) are out for New Orleans, while Egor Demin (leg bruise) is out for Brooklyn and Mikel Brown Jr. (rest) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Pelicans won the last meeting 116-113 in New Orleans on January 14, 2026, though they have not yet met this season.
